g.text: The tracked build-out is almost entirely American

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: What it shows: observed compute and tracked site count by country. The single most important structural fact about the

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: dataset, and the reason it cannot be read as a picture of global capacity.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — data_centers.csv + data_center_timelines.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: Observed data only, at the 2026-08-06 snapshot. The United States holds 93.9% of observed compute across 68 of 77 tracked sites. That

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: is partly real and partly coverage: Epoch states the database is strongest in the US and is still expanding elsewhere, so non-US

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: capacity is understated by an unknown margin rather than absent. United Arab Emirates, Australia appear with tracked sites but no

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: observed compute yet. Chinese capacity in particular is known to be larger than the three sites recorded here.
